ZMB.note: Document names no national digital strategy.
Document names no online service for citizens or businesses; its systems are for local authorities' internal use.

facts.fact: SMART Zambia's e-Government Division, a government body, says it deployed the Government Wide Area Network to all 116 local authorities and rolled out the CDF-MIS and CFW-MIS management information systems for the Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development, per TechAfrica News.

SMART Zambia's e-Government Division announced full deployment of the Government Wide Area Network across all 116 local authorities, per TechAfrica News; the document does not say what staff do over it.
SMART Zambia says GWAN is deployed in all 116 local authorities, per TechAfrica News.
